notes.title: Bug Fix For Gun Upgrades in the Shop
notes.notes: There was a game-breaking bug where it tried to reference a variable that didn't exist when buying an upgrade. It was specifically on the Magnum weapon.

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 Is Live Now
notes.notes:
I finally added music to fit the themes of the levels I have in the game. 

The Options menu now actually does something. You can change the volume of the Music and SFX separately. Some graphical glitches with the splash screen were fixed as well. 

I updated some of the objectives regarding keys and also display the keys you currently have in the top-left corner of the screen.

In addition to all of that, I have a new tutorial blurb that pops up when you start a new game. It better kicks off the story and gives some assistance on what to do next. You can still read this message in the room you spawn in if you're still working through the demo. 

There's a slew of bug fixes, so it should just run smoother in general. 

Hope you enjoy it! 
Flint
